topics.name: Developer-Relations-Led GTM
topics.top_questions: How do you attribute revenue or retained usage back to a specific city stop — what metric says a stop worked? · With Nebius having acquired Tavily, is this still a partnership or one company's GTM wearing two logos? · A new CMO started roughly seven weeks before the tour launched — did the tour concept predate that hire? · What is different about growing a developer community around AI infrastructure now versus communications APIs a decade ago?

topics.name: AI Sales Agents
topics.top_questions: Where is the one step in an agent's flow you decided NOT to let it act on alone — and what would have broken if you had? · Does a sales agent have a sandbox equivalent — an environment safe to fail in before it touches a real prospect — or does the live-prospect surface make after-the-fact observability the only workable model? · When an agent fails a scenario nobody tested for, is it more often a bad-data problem or a bad-judgment problem? · Does 'run more campaigns with fewer people' mean leverage per rep or smaller teams?

topics.name: Agent Autonomy & Human-in-the-Loop in Production
topics.top_questions:
1. Is the permission ceiling scoped per task class by measured track record, or is it an all-or-nothing toggle?
2. Are approval gates triggered by risk signal or by action category — the fatigue curves differ sharply?
3. When the approval queue backs up, does an unanswered item default to approve or deny?
4. What is your equivalent of plan-only mode — the fallback that keeps an agent out of prod when it misreads a signal?
5. Has anyone measured their own reviewers' agreement rate on what counts as risky?

topics.name: Trusting Agent PRs (review thresholds & agentic reviewers)
topics.top_questions:
1. Have you enabled AI-approval-counts-toward-required-reviewers anywhere — and which paths did you deliberately exclude?
2. Is your reviewer agent the same model family as your generator, and how would you know it is not agreeing with its own blind spots?
3. Who writes the standard of done, and does it exist before the code does?
4. What track record promotes an agent from advisory to trusted — and what demotes it?
5. Is the relaxation of review driven by new evidence, or by velocity pressure?

topics.name: Closed-Loop Remediation (agents fixing agents, automated rollback)
topics.top_questions:
1. If the same model writes the bug and the fix, is that redundancy or correlated failure — and how would you test the difference?
2. Is your fix-agent a balancing loop or a reinforcing one, and what is the evidence rather than the intuition?
3. What is your retry budget, and was the number tested or guessed?
4. Is burn rate computed against the canary slice or global traffic?
5. For which class of service is automated rollback actually unsafe?

topics.name: Centaur vs. Reverse Centaur (who shapes the work in AI-assisted jobs)

Which artifacts should an agent be allowed to draft but never approve? Does 'amplified vs diminished' (Lenny's 2026 survey: a top predictor of career optimism) show up in your team's AI rollout?
